title: skills-sh-jezweb-claude-skills-claude-agent-sdk
summary: # Changelog ## 0.3.304 - Added `suspendSseStream(query)` and `resumeSseStream(query)` to the browser SDK: close a query's event stream and reopen it later without ending the query - Added stable row ids to `getContextUsage()`, and, when the CLI answers on its own stdio, plugin ids, agent and skill file paths, and per-server MCP instruction token shares - Fixed `startup()` timing out while a SessionStart or Setup command hook was running when no `initializeTimeoutMs` is passed: up to 10 minutes of that time no longer counts toward the 60-second limit, and the timeout error now says what the process reported - Fixed `startup()` keeping every `hook_progress` message of a running SessionStart or Setup hook in memory until it resolved; it now keeps only the newest one for each hook - Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.304 ## 0.3.303 - Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.303 ## 0.3.302
type: skills
tags: skills-sh, skills-sh-all-time
source_url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-typescript/main/CHANGELOG.md
